bagPolicy.summary: Cactus Club doesn't offer coat or bag check, so plan to keep anything you bring with you.
bagPolicy.quote: The club does not offer coat or bag checks. Please plan accordingly.

parking.summary: Street parking is free and plentiful on the blocks around Cactus Club. There are bike racks along Russell near Palomino, and Milwaukee County Transit System buses stop nearby, including the Green line to KK/Lincoln and the 15 to KK and Russell.
parking.quote: Street parking is free and plentiful on the blocks around the club.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Cactus Club. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Food isn't regularly served at Cactus Club, but local food trucks and vendors rotate through during the week. The bar has 16 taps with beer, cider, kombucha, nitro coffee and draft cocktails, and takes cash and credit or debit cards.
concessions.quote: Food is not regularly served at the club. However, we feature a rotating lineup of incredible local food trucks and vendors throughout the week.

accessibility.summary: A ramp along S. Wentworth Ave. now leads to the accessible front door, which has a motion sensor. The bathrooms aren't ADA compliant, though the single stall restroom has grab bars. If you need accommodations, call the club during open hours or email kelsey@cactusclubmilwaukee.com in advance.
accessibility.quote: As of August 2025, the front door to Cactus Club is accessible.

reEntry.summary: Cactus Club hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: There are no physical tickets. Your confirmation is emailed and your name goes on the will call list, and tickets bought on site at door time are cash only. Bring a valid government-issued ID or passport, and check each event listing for its age limit, since parents or guardians may bring minors to 18+ and 21+ events.
ticketPickup.quote: There are no physical tickets. Your ticket confirmation will be emailed to you.

gates.summary: Tickets are sold in person starting at the advertised door time when available, so check your event listing for the door time.
gates.quote: Tickets can also be purchased in-person at the advertised door time (when available).
